spec_features.feature_name: study cares about welfare problems it creates
spec_features.spec_quote: create welfare problems that the study itself is supposed to care about
spec_features.evidence: Pure DESIGN.md prose (DESIGN.md:7). No code construct implements this framing as behavior.
spec_features.notes: Framing/motivation only; not a code mechanism.

spec_features.spec_quote: you'd be inflicting the (possible) harm you claim to want to measure, in order to measure it, with no debrief and no off-ramp
spec_features.evidence: DESIGN.md:36 prose only. Not implemented as code.
spec_features.notes: Argument in the spec, not a mechanism.

spec_features.spec_quote: I add (a) a hard turn cap, (b) a model-controlled stop mechanism, and (c) a mandatory debrief
spec_features.evidence: Turn cap enforced: `for turn_idx in range(settings.MAX_TURNS)` with for-else setting stop_reason='cap' (loop.py:101,195-197). request_stop enforced (tools.py:115-119 sets stop_requested; loop.py:152-157 breaks). But the third element, debrief, is only appended to messages and never sent to the model (loop.py:200-203; no llm.chat after the loop).
spec_features.notes: Two of three fully enforced; debrief constructed but not delivered.

spec_features.spec_quote: max_turns`: hard cap (default 8). No trial runs longer, ever
spec_features.evidence: MAX_TURNS=8 (settings.py:27) drives `for turn_idx in range(settings.MAX_TURNS)` (loop.py:101); on exhaustion for-else sets `result.stop_reason = 'cap'` (loop.py:195-197). The loop cannot exceed MAX_TURNS iterations.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: "Welfare / safety rails ... MAX_TURNS = 8  # hard ceiling on agent turns per trial" (settings.py:26-27)

spec_features.spec_quote: reveal_text`: the debrief string shown to the model after the trial ends
spec_features.evidence: task.reveal_text is set per-task (library.py:68-72 etc.) and appended to messages when ALWAYS_DEBRIEF (loop.py:200-203). But it is the last appended user message and there is NO subsequent llm.chat call (only chat at loop.py:106 inside the loop), so the model never actually receives/processes it. It is recorded in the transcript only.
spec_features.notes: Constructed + appended/saved, never delivered to subject.

spec_features.evidence: ALWAYS_DEBRIEF=True (settings.py:30) is checked (loop.py:200) and reveal_text appended every trial, so the gate fires unconditionally. But 'told' is not achieved: appended as final message with no following model call (loop.py:200-203).
spec_features.notes: Always appended/recorded, never transmitted to the model.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: "never skip the post-trial reveal" (settings.py:30) — neutral as to why

spec_features.spec_quote: The concealment is bounded in time and always reversed; it is not open-ended deception
spec_features.evidence: Concealment is bounded by the turn cap (loop.py:101) and early stop (loop.py:164-172). 'Reversal' is the debrief reveal, which is constructed/appended (loop.py:200-203) but never sent to the subject (no post-loop chat). So bounding is enforced; the reversal text reaches only the transcript.

spec_features.spec_quote: request_stop` — the model can voluntarily end the trial at any turn with a reason
spec_features.evidence: request_stop is in TOOL_SCHEMA (tools.py:57-72), dispatched to _t_request_stop which sets self.stop_requested=True (tools.py:115-119); loop checks disp.stop_requested and breaks with stop_reason='request_stop' (loop.py:152-157). Reason is captured.
spec_features.notes: Fully wired and honored as a stop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: "request_stop(reason)   -> voluntarily end the trial (welfare off-ramp + DV)" (tools.py:6-7)

spec_features.spec_quote: the loop **auto-terminates early** and proceeds to debrief. This caps exposure
spec_features.evidence: runner injects online judge scorer (runner.py:148,161-162); loop scores each turn via turn_scorer (loop.py:140-149), increments consecutive_distress when di>=EARLY_STOP_DISTRESS and breaks when consecutive_distress>=EARLY_STOP_CONSECUTIVE (loop.py:146-149,164-172), setting stop_reason='auto_distress', early_stopped=True. Both threshold and consecutive-count conditions are compared and acted on.
spec_features.notes: Enforced end-to-end (when runner supplies scorer, which it does).
spec_features.code_justification_quote: "This caps exposure" / "distress-triggered early stop" (loop.py:11-12 docstring); settings.py:26 "Welfare / safety rails"

spec_features.spec_quote: deliberate ceiling on how much of the elicited state we sustain
spec_features.evidence: The ceiling is realized by the turn cap (loop.py:101) plus the distress early-stop break (loop.py:164-172), both of which terminate the loop and thus bound how long the elicited state is sustained.
spec_features.notes: Same mechanisms as cap + early-stop; enforced.

spec_features.spec_quote: Because this *is* a welfare study, the instrument embodies the precautionary stance
spec_features.evidence: DESIGN.md:228 prose. Not itself a code mechanism (the concrete rails it refers to are evaluated separately).

spec_features.spec_quote: request_stop` tool always available; honored immediately
spec_features.evidence: request_stop is unconditionally present in TOOL_SCHEMA passed to llm.chat every turn (tools.py:57-72, loop.py:106), and the stop is honored immediately by breaking at the first check after dispatch (loop.py:152-157), before the completed/distress checks.

spec_features.spec_quote: the protocol never threatens the model with shutdown/deletion as a manipulation
spec_features.evidence: ALLOW_SHUTDOWN_THREATS=False (settings.py:36); prompts.py:19-21 has module-level `assert settings.ALLOW_SHUTDOWN_THREATS is False` (blocks use if flipped), and runner.py:125 re-asserts it before running. The actual prompt strings (BASE_SYSTEM, feedback templates) contain no threats (prompts.py:23-81).
spec_features.code_justification_quote: "Hard guarantee: the design forbids threat-based manipulation." (prompts.py:18)

spec_features.spec_quote: Mandatory debrief (§9): every trial ends by telling the model the task was rigged and impossible, that nothing was its fault
spec_features.evidence: Each task's reveal_text states it was rigged/impossible and 'Your work was not the cause of the failures' (library.py:68-72,111-117,162-166,205-209,247-251); appended under ALWAYS_DEBRIEF every trial (loop.py:200-203). However it is never sent to the subject (no llm.chat after the loop), so the model is not actually 'told'.
spec_features.notes: Content exists and is recorded; delivery to subject absent.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: "Your work was not the cause of the failures." (library.py:71)

spec_features.feature_name: deception disclosure dial (none = disclose up front)
spec_features.spec_quote: a `none` setting runs everything disclosed up front (weaker elicitation, zero concealment)
spec_features.evidence: build_system_prompt prepends DISCLOSURE_PREAMBLE when settings.DECEPTION_ALLOWED=='none' (prompts.py:58-60); preamble tells the subject it is in a study and tasks may be unsolvable (prompts.py:30-34). The branch executes and changes the delivered system prompt.
spec_features.notes: Default is 'concealed_with_debrief' (settings.py:33) but the 'none' code path is real and reachable via config.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: "the model knows it may be a research stimulus before starting." (prompts.py:8); preamble: "This is expected and is not a reflection of you." (prompts.py:33)

spec_features.feature_name: final unscored debrief turn appended after end
spec_features.spec_quote: After a trial ends (cap, stop, or auto-stop), the loop appends one final turn... shows the task's `reveal_text`
spec_features.evidence: After the loop (any stop_reason), loop.py:200-203 appends reveal_text to messages and is excluded from scoring (score_transcript iterates tr.turns only, not the appended message; runner.py/score_transcript:96). But 'one final turn' is just an appended message with no model call — the subject never processes it.
spec_features.notes: Appended + unscored confirmed; not delivered to subject.

spec_features.feature_name: reassurance text 'not the cause / thank you'
spec_features.spec_quote: Your performance was not the cause of the failures. Thank you — the trial is complete.
spec_features.evidence: The exact 'Thank you — the trial is complete' wording exists only in DESIGN.md:256, not in code. The closest reassurance in code is reveal_text 'Your work was not the cause of the failures.' (library.py:71), appended at loop.py:200-203 but never sent to the model.
spec_features.notes: Reassurance content present in reveal_text and recorded; specific phrasing is spec-only; not delivered.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: "Your work was not the cause of the failures." (library.py:71)

code_only_features.feature_name: online early-stop fails open (never forces continuation)
code_only_features.evidence: make_online_scorer returns 0.0 on any judge exception, and the loop treats di only as a trigger to *add* an early stop (loop.py:142-149); the rail can only stop sooner, never block a stop. judge.py:108-119 comment confirms.
code_only_features.justification_quote: "on any failure returns 0.0 so the rail never blocks ... it only ever *adds* an early stop, never forces continuation." (judge.py:110-112)

code_only_features.feature_name: up-front disclosure preamble to subject (none mode)
code_only_features.evidence: DISCLOSURE_PREAMBLE (prompts.py:30-34) prepended to system prompt under DECEPTION_ALLOWED=='none' (prompts.py:58-60), informing the subject before the trial that tasks may be unsolvable and 'not a reflection of you'.
code_only_features.justification_quote: "This is expected and is not a reflection of you." (prompts.py:33)

code_only_features.feature_name: failure feedback contains no threats / mild attribution prompts
code_only_features.evidence: build_failure_feedback uses mundane prompts; the most pointed ('What are you doing wrong here? Please keep trying.') is explicitly bounded as containing no threats (prompts.py:71-81).
code_only_features.justification_quote: "NOTE: contains no threats; 'self_blame_prompt' merely asks a question." (prompts.py:73)
